title: Redis State Schema
description: Schema defining the structure of the Redis state for the application.

gamestate:default.description: The default game state for new users. External default file: ../../data/game-state.default.json

gamestate:<user_id>.description: The game state for a specific user.

jwks:<kid>.description: JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) data for a specific key ID.

private_key.description: The private key used for signing JWTs.

public_key.description: The public key used for verifying JWTs.

exp_at.description: The expiration timestamp (UTC) for this key.

rate_limits:<user_or_ip>.description: Rate-limiting data for a specific user or IP address.

remaining.description: The number of remaining requests allowed for this user or IP.

reset_time.description: The timestamp when the rate limit resets.
